scope: New results relative to supplied record; no worldwide-priority claim.

results.name: Maximal-flat fibre rigidity
results.statement: In an admissible two-colour partition of F_3^n, quotient in the direction of a maximum-dimensional affine subspace contained in R. The full remainder fibres form a cap of size 1,2,4; all but at most one nonfull fibre have a monochromatic affine coloured complement.

results.name: Occupied-fibre inheritance
results.statement: Under the hypotheses of M1, the quotient set of fibres meeting R inherits an admissible two-colouring.

results.name: Sharp plane-free threshold in F_3^3
results.statement: The maximum cardinality of a plane-free admissible two-colour remainder in F_3^3 is exactly 16.
results.status: written proof and explicit sharp construction; finite controls passed

results.name: All-dimension plane-free bound
results.statement: For n>=3, a plane-free admissible two-colour remainder in F_3^n has cardinality at most (5/2)*2^n-4. At density >=1/10, an affine plane is forced for n>=8.
results.limitations: No sharpness claim beyond dimension 3; no improvement to general O(k log k) codimension.

results.name: Tail exponent rigidity and ascent
results.statement: For a law with full support on N_0 and -log p_n=c*n^beta+o(n^beta), its coordinate ratio-gradient G_n/(c*n^beta) tends to 1+rho-2*rho*min(1,2^(1-beta)). Stationarity at rho>1 therefore requires beta=log_2(4*rho/(1+rho)). Nonzero coefficient gives a strict finite-coordinate ascent direction.
results.status: written proof; exact formal finite controls passed
results.limitations: One-sided full support and stated regular tail required; no existence or sufficiency claim.

results.name: Prescribed-tail supremum equality
results.statement: For every fixed beta,c>0, the supremum of rho over full N_0 laws with -log p_n~c*n^beta equals the unrestricted finite-entropy discrete-real supremum C_*. Finite rational nonnegative-integer laws have the same supremum.

results.name: Gaussian-tail nonattainment
results.statement: Every fixed one-sided full-support Gaussian-log-tail class (-log p_n~c*n^2) has supremum C_* but no maximizer. An attainer with any regular exponent beta must satisfy log_2(4*L/(1+L))<beta<=log_2(8/3), where L=1.4051810329.
results.limitations: Does not rule out arbitrary irregular or sparse extremizers; numerical bounds unchanged.

certification_scope: No proof assistant or external peer review. Exact finite controls do not establish infinite/general theorems by themselves.
